fact: Minister Zerrouki told the APN that Algeria is connected to the global internet through four submarine cable systems, SEA-ME-WE 4, Medex, Orval (Oran-Valence) and Alval (Alger-Valence), plus an Alger-Palma cable; the document names Oran and Algiers as separate cable origins but does not use the words landing station.
Ecofin says Algeria is connected to Europe through the Orval-Alval cable to Spain and the Medex cable to France.
The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications said maintenance on the Algeria-Spain submarine cable was completed overnight 26-27 October 2026 and internet service returned to normal.
The ministry said data traffic was switched beforehand to other submarine cables, so main internet services were not affected during the works.
Algerie Telecom's CEO says its subsidiary Algerie Telecom Europe manages the submarine cables linking Algeria to the major data backbones in Europe and the global network.
Algérie Télécom says its network links Algeria abroad through the SeaMeWe4, MEDEX, ORVAL/ALVAL and MAREA submarine cables and through land cables to neighbouring countries such as Tunisia.
system: SeaMeWe4, MEDEX, ORVAL/ALVAL, MAREA, terrestrial link to Tunisia

fact: Algerie Telecom's deck lists submarine routes from Oran (Oran-Valence), Algiers (Alger-Valence, Alger-Palma) and Annaba (SMW4 to Marseille and Palermo), plus MEDEX and an underground land cable from El Kala to Tabarka in Tunisia, with international gateway POPs at Algiers (since 2001), Annaba (2010) and Oran (2012).
